description: Elections Commission - Parliamentary Election - 2024. Declaration Article 99A of the Constitution (National List- 2024)
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration of election results for Members of Parliament under Article 99A of the Constitution. It specifically announces that individuals have been duly elected as Members of Parliament for their respective parties, which falls under electoral processes and election results declarations. This matches the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) which covers "election results and declarations" and "candidate nominations and registrations."
